findings.reason: a pre-query in one caller leaves the defect type in place at a second site; extending the owner (a create-only mode on `GraphClient.create_nodes`, or the module's own `ON CREATE SET`) fixes every FacilityPath creator once and lets `create_child_paths` be corrected or removed.
findings.text: the §14 seed-fix makes `seed_facility_roots` additive by pre-querying which paths already exist (the `p.path IN $paths` filter lifted from `seed_missing_roots` at frontier.py:587), but the clobbering write it is working around is `MERGE (n {id}) SET n += item` in the node-creation owner `GraphClient.create_nodes` (imas_codex/graph/client.py:605, the SET at client.py:667), and the established create-if-absent mechanism in this same module is `MERGE … ON CREATE SET`, used thirteen times (frontier.py:903,933,1014,1187,1217,1445,2151,2169,2193,2242,2283,2341,2381) and mirrored by `GraphClient.ensure_facility` (client.py:753); the same unguarded create remains at `create_child_paths` (frontier.py:643, `create_nodes` at :694, hardcoding `status=discovered` and `depth` so any existing scored child would be reset), which has no live caller (referenced only in the docstring at frontier.py:1823)

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the shared renderer collapses eight inline `STARTS WITH` path clauses to one function (callers at imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py:484,540,597,715,795; imas_codex/discovery/code/graph_ops.py:141,566; imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:98), and the remaining seed fix folds an existing one-function wrapper into its owner; §14 adds no new shallow layer.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan implements the create-without-clobber invariant as a second mechanism (an existence pre-query moved from seed_missing_roots into seed_facility_roots) instead of adopting the create-if-absent idiom the owning module already uses in thirteen places.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §14 adds no surface in any family and explicitly names the one public definition it retires (the `seed_missing_roots` export from imas_codex/discovery/__init__.py and imas_codex/discovery/paths/__init__.py), while its runs reuse the already-landed `--root`, `--path-prefix` and `--reset-to` options.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §14 names and reuses the mechanisms it extends: `seed_missing_roots` (imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py:587) for the existence filter, `render_path_prefix_clause` (imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:268) for the prefix predicate, `reset_to_status` and the ResetSpec tables (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:59,254,363), and `get_facility` (imas_codex/discovery/base/facility.py) for the committed root list; no new subsystem is introduced.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan retires the thin wrapper `seed_missing_roots` (frontier.py:587, which only computes a missing set and delegates to `seed_facility_roots`) by moving its filter into the function it wraps, rather than adding a parallel wrapper.
